headword: {姉|あね}さん{女房|にょうぼう}

definitions.gloss: a wife who is older than her husband
definitions.explanation: A wife who is older than her husband, especially one who takes the lead in the marriage like an older sister. Used warmly or humorously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}さん→奥さん：02853_okusan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{姉|あね}さん{女房|にょうぼう}だ。
examples.english: His wife is older than he is.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{姉|あね}さん{女房|にょうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: He married a woman three years older than himself.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}さん{女房|にょうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦しっかりした→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧になった。
examples.english: Thanks to his older wife, he has become a thoroughly responsible man.

notes:
A traditional saying holds that a wife a year or so older brings good fortune: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女房|にょうぼう}→女房：12212_nyoubou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{草鞋|わらじ}→草鞋：29127_waraji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}いて→履く：00700_haku⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{探|さが}せ→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (search for a wife one year older even if you must wear out iron sandals).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {姉|あね}さん{女房|にょうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to marry an older woman
- ⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧: an older wife (neutral description)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{女房|にょうぼう}→女房：12212_nyoubou⟧: one's wife (informal, a little old-fashioned)
